pokedex-text: In this section, we focus on exploring the original Pokémon, those that were part of the first generations of the Pokémon universe, as well as Pokémon created by the community. The original Pokémon, known for their unique designs and characteristics, remain the most beloved by fans. On the other hand, community Pokémon are those designed by community members, based on their creativity and inspiration. These Pokémon can include new types, abilities, or evolutions, showcasing the incredible passion and talent of Pokémon followers. Here, you can discover both the classics and the fan innovations, celebrating the diversity of the Pokémon world.

poketools_text: Poketools is your operations center to optimize every battle and strategy in the Pokémon world. Here, you will find essential tools such as IV/EV calculators that will allow you to perfect and maximize your Pokémon's stats, ensuring that each one performs at its best in battle. In addition, our calculators for advantages and disadvantages offer a detailed analysis of your team's types and synergies, allowing you to plan effective strategies and make informed tactical decisions. Whether you seek to perfect your team for competitions or simply want to experiment and have fun, Poketools provides you with precise and reliable resources to take your battles to the next level.
communitymon_text: This is the creative space where the community becomes the true protagonist. This section offers you the freedom to create, edit, and even delete your own Pokémon, giving you the opportunity to capture all those unique ideas and inspirations you've had about fantastic creatures. Here, we encourage collaboration and innovation, inviting you to share your creations with other fans and discover new perspectives through the work of other community members. Explore, experiment, and reinvent the Pokémon universe, making Communitymon a vibrant place full of creativity where every contribution counts.
pokeplay_text: Welcome to Pokeplay, your new space for fun and ingenuity in the Pokémon universe. Here, you can enjoy exciting interactive challenges, such as the classic 'Who's that Pokémon?' that will test your ability to recognize them at first glance, or the challenge of guessing from a detailed description. In addition, the popular pokemondle will challenge you to identify your favorite Pokémon based on carefully crafted clues and riddles. This section is designed for both veteran and new fans, offering a playful and dynamic experience that combines knowledge with a passion for the Pokémon world. Each game is an opportunity to learn something new, improve your skills, and share moments of fun with other trainers.
menu_text: Welcome to your Pokémon space, where you can explore everything you've achieved on your adventure. Quickly access your favorite Pokémon to view their details, check out the list of all the Pokémon you've captured so far, and best of all, create your own custom Pokémon to add to your collection. Your journey as a trainer is just beginning, and here you have everything you need to make it even more exciting!
home_text: Welcome to our dedicated platform for Pokémon fans, where the experience is taken to the next level. On our site you will be able to access a variety of tools designed to enhance your trainer experience. If you need to optimize your Pokémon, we have powerful IV/EV calculators to help you maximize the potential of your creatures. In addition, you will be able to analyze the strengths and weaknesses of your teams with a specific tool that allows you to make strategic decisions and dominate each battle. Our SQL database stores a vast repertoire of information, from the most technical characteristics to curious details about each Pokémon. But it's not all about strategy, we also offer fun interactive games such as guessing the Pokémon from its image or its description in the Pokédex. The Pokédex includes not only the traditional Pokémon of the region, but also a community version, where users can create and share their own Pokémon, expanding the universe even further. If you decide to register, you will have the opportunity to create your own customized Pokémon, interact with other users and take advantage of all the platform's exclusive features - join our community and take your passion for Pokémon to new heights!

teams-text: In this section you can create and manage your Pokémon teams. Organize your favorite Pokémon in strategic teams, customize their names and descriptions, and prepare for battle. Here you can create new teams, edit existing ones, and delete those you no longer need. Build the perfect team for each occasion!
